mapper.select: select c.id, c.request_no as requestNo, c.season_id as seasonId, c.change_type as changeType, c.request_status as requestStatus, c.player_id as playerId, c.source_event_team_id as sourceEventTeamId, c.target_event_team_id as targetEventTeamId, c.submit_time as submitTime, c.reviewed_time as reviewedTime, pp.game_nickname as playerNickname, s.season_name as seasonName from basket_tournament_roster_change_request c inner join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = c.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile pp on pp.id = c.player_id and pp.is_delete = 0 where c.is_delete = 0 and c.season_id = #{seasonId} and c.change_type = #{changeType} and c.request_status = #{requestStatus} order by c.submit_time desc, c.id desc
